scope: Frozen source-heavy-atom Uni-Mol2; original XYZ, original domains and all proposals retained. Element and source-size support exclusions separate; no reward, selection or generator changes.
mae_definition: Equal target-quantile weighting; original-domain evaluable proposals. Candidate budgets are recorded per arm. Conditions reuse frozen pools and are not new training repeats.
timing_scope: Sum of successful HOMO/LUMO evaluation worker intervals; excludes model loading, provenance hashing and failed partial rerun; not parallel end-to-end elapsed time.
